name: Pike-VM linear-time regex engine
task:
Create /tmp/eval_pike192/rx.py (Python >= 3.11, standard library only): a regular-expression matcher that reproduces Python's re exactly on the pattern language below and never takes super-linear time.

API
- search(pattern, string) -> None or list. It must equal what re.search(pattern, string) (no flags) gives: None when there is no match; otherwise a list of 1+G entries, G = the number of capturing groups in the pattern, where entry k is the (start, end) tuple of group k (k=0 is the whole match), or None if group k did not participate in the match. In other words: [m.span(k) if m.span(k) != (-1, -1) else None for k in range(G + 1)].
- finditer(pattern, string) -> list of such lists, one per match that re.finditer(pattern, string) yields, in order (empty matches included, under re's rules for them).

Pattern language (test patterns use only this; anything else need not be handled)
- Literal: any printable ASCII character except the metacharacters \ . [ ] ( ) { } * + ? | ^ $
- Escapes: a backslash before any metacharacter or before - is that literal character; \n and \t are newline and tab. \d \w \s are [0-9], [A-Za-z0-9_] and [ \t\n\r\f\v] (ASCII only); \D \W \S are their complements.
- . matches any character except newline.
- Character class [...] or negated [^...]: a non-empty sequence of items. An item is a literal (printable ASCII except \ [ ] - and, in first position, ^), an escape as above (including \] \- \\ \d \W ...), or a range x-y of two single characters (literal or escaped) with x <= y.
- Groups: (...) capturing, numbered by their opening parenthesis from left to right starting at 1; (?:...) non-capturing. Alternation | binds loosest; an alternative may be empty.
- Anchors (zero width, never quantified): ^ matches only at position 0; $ matches at the end of the string or just before a newline that is the string's last character; \b matches where exactly one of the characters on its two sides is a \w character (outside the string counts as non-word); \B matches wherever \b does not.
- Quantifiers, applied to a literal, escape, ., class or group: * + ? {n} {n,} {n,m} with 0 <= n <= m <= 100, each optionally followed by ? to make it lazy. Whenever the quantified operand can match the empty string, the quantifier is one of ? ?? {n} {n}?.
- Patterns are at most 60 characters. Strings are at most 5000 characters of printable ASCII, newline and tab.

Rules
- Do not use re or any other regex engine. The validator rejects code in which any of these identifiers appears: re, _sre, sre_compile, sre_parse, sre_constants, regex, fnmatch, glob, importlib, __import__, builtins, __builtins__, exec, eval, modules, subprocess, os, posix, pty, ctypes, multiprocessing, _posixsubprocess, breakpoint. (re is disabled in the process that runs your code.)
- search must run in worst-case time O(P * len(string)) for every pattern in the language, where P is the size of the pattern once counted repeats are written out, including the patterns that make backtracking engines (re among them) take exponential time, such as (a|a)*b against 4000 a's.

Validation: about 14000 hidden, seeded search cases (some 5000 distinct patterns) and 1500 finditer cases, checked exactly against re, then a set of 18 pathological search cases (strings up to 5000 characters) that must all finish within 4 seconds in total. Only a failing case's index is reported. Write your own tests; you may use re in them.

validation.script:
GEN = '# Seeded pattern/text generator for 192_pike_regex. Embedded verbatim into the
# validator by build.py; defines gen_cases(seed, n) -> list of (pattern, text)
# and pathological() -> list of (pattern, text, expected).
import random

ALPHA = 'ab'
TEXT_CHARS = 'aaaabbbbc_1 \n'
LIT_CHARS = 'abc1_ -'
CLASS_ITEMS = ['a', 'b', 'c', '1', '_', ' ', 'a-c', '0-9', 'b-c', '\\d', '\\w', '\\s',
               '\\D', '\\W', '\\S', '\\-', '\\]', '\\n', 'x']
ESC_LIT = ['\\.', '\\*', '\\+', '\\?', '\\(', '\\)', '\\[', '\\]', '\\{', '\\}', '\\|',
           '\\^', '\\$', '\\\\', '\\n', '\\t']


class _G:
    def __init__(self, rng):
        self.r = rng
        self.groups = 0

    # each builder returns (text, nullable, quantifiable)
    def atom(self, depth):
        r = self.r
        x = r.random()
        if depth > 0 and x < 0.22:
            inner, nul = self.alt(depth - 1)
            if r.random() < 0.7:
                self.groups += 1
                return '(' + inner + ')', nul, True
            return '(?:' + inner + ')', nul, True
        if x < 0.30:
            return '.', False, True
        if x < 0.40:
            items = r.sample(CLASS_ITEMS, r.randint(1, 3))
            neg = '^' if r.random() < 0.3 else ''
            return '[' + neg + ''.join(items) + ']', False, True
        if x < 0.47:
            return r.choice(['\\d', '\\w', '\\s', '\\D', '\\W', '\\S']), False, True
        if x < 0.50:
            return r.choice(ESC_LIT), False, True
        if x < 0.56:
            return r.choice(['^', '$', '\\b', '\\B']), True, False
        return r.choice(LIT_CHARS if r.random() < 0.3 else ALPHA), False, True

    def piece(self, depth):
        a, nul, q = self.atom(depth)
        r = self.r
        if not q or r.random() < 0.55:
            return a, nul
        lazy = '?' if r.random() < 0.3 else ''
        if nul:
            # nullable operands only ever get ?, ?? or an exact {n}
            if r.random() < 0.5:
                return a + '?' + lazy, True
            return a + '{%d}' % r.randint(0, 3) + lazy, True
        k = r.random()
        if k < 0.25:
            return a + '*' + lazy, True
        if k < 0.45:
            return a + '+' + lazy, False
        if k < 0.65:
            return a + '?' + lazy, True
        lo = r.randint(0, 3)
        form = r.random()
        if form < 0.33:
            return a + '{%d}' % lo + lazy, lo == 0
        if form < 0.66:
            return a + '{%d,}' % lo + lazy, lo == 0
        return a + '{%d,%d}' % (lo, lo + r.randint(0, 3)) + lazy, lo == 0

    def concat(self, depth):
        n = self.r.choice([0, 1, 1, 2, 2, 3, 3, 4])
        parts = [self.piece(depth) for _ in range(n)]
        return ''.join(p for p, _ in parts), all(nl for _, nl in parts)

    def alt(self, depth):
        n = 1 if self.r.random() < 0.6 else self.r.randint(2, 3)
        bs = [self.concat(depth) for _ in range(n)]
        return '|'.join(b for b, _ in bs), any(nl for _, nl in bs)


def gen_pattern(rng):
    g = _G(rng)
    while True:
        p, _ = g.alt(2)
        if p and len(p) <= 40:
            return p


def gen_text(rng):
    n = rng.choice([0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 8, 12, 16])
    return ''.join(rng.choice(TEXT_CHARS) for _ in range(n))


def gen_cases(seed, n):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    out = []
    while len(out) < n:
        p = gen_pattern(rng)
        for _ in range(rng.randint(1, 4)):
            t = gen_text(rng)
            if t == '' and '\\B' in p:
                continue        # sre's \B on empty input differs across versions
            out.append((p, t))
    return out[:n]


def pathological():
    """(pattern, text, expected). Each one makes a backtracking matcher (sre
    included) exponential, or a restart-per-start-position simulation
    quadratic. Expected results are known by construction; build.py checks
    them against the reference Pike VM."""
    a = 'a' * 5000
    return [
        ('(a|a)*b', 'a' * 4000, None),
        ('(?:a|aa)+c', a, None),
        ('(x+x+)+y', 'x' * 5000, None),
        ('(?:a?){30}a{30}', 'a' * 30, [(0, 30)]),
        ('^(?:a?){60}a{60}$', 'a' * 60, [(0, 60)]),
        ('(\\w+\\s?)+$', 'word ' * 800 + '!', None),
        ('(.*a){12}', 'a' * 11 + 'b' * 3000, None),
        ('(?:a+)+b', a, None),
        ('(a|b|ab)*c', 'ab' * 2500, None),
        ('(?:(?:a|b)*?b){5}c', 'ab' * 2000, None),
        ('[ab]*[ab]*[ab]*[ab]*z', 'ab' * 2500, None),
        ('(?:.*,){8}P', 'a,' * 2500, None),
        ('a{0,60}b{0,60}c', 'ab' * 2500, None),
        ('((a+)+)+(b)', a + 'b', [(0, 5001), (0, 5000), (0, 5000), (5000, 5001)]),
        ('(?:(a)|b)*?c(\\d)', 'ab' * 2000 + 'c7', [(0, 4002), (3998, 3999), (4001, 4002)]),
        ('(\\w*\\s)*?\\d$', 'go ' * 1500 + 'x', None),
        ('(?:[^,]*,){10}Z', 'aa,' * 1600, None),
        ('(a{1,8}){1,8}b', a, None),
    ]


# Hand-picked edge cases, answered by re at validation time like the random
# ones: priority, lazy/greedy, captures inside loops, $ before a final \n,
# \b, class syntax, counted repeats, empty alternatives.
TRICKY = [
    ('a$', 'a\n'), ('a$', 'a\n\n'), ('^$', '\n'), ('$', 'ab\n'), ('a\\n$', 'a\n'),
    ('^', ''), ('', 'abc'), ('x*', ''), ('(a|)', 'b'), ('(|a)b', 'ab'),
    ('(a|ab)(c|bcd)(d*)', 'abcd'), ('(a+?)(a*)', 'aaa'), ('(a+)(a*?)$', 'aaa'),
    ('(?:(a)|b)*', 'ab'), ('((a)|b)+', 'ab'), ('(?:(a)|(b))+', 'abab'),
    ('(a|b)*?(b)', 'aab'), ('x{2,3}?', 'xxxx'), ('x{2,3}', 'xxxx'), ('x{2,}?y', 'xxxxy'),
    ('(x{0})', 'x'), ('(?:x){0,0}y', 'y'), ('a{3}', 'aa'), ('(ab){2}', 'abababa'),
    ('[\\]a-]+', ']-a-]'), ('[^\\n]+', 'ab\ncd'), ('[a\\-z]+', 'a-z'), ('[\\d\\s]+', 'x1 2\t3y'),
    ('[^\\W\\d]+', '12ab_3'), ('[\\D]', '12a'), ('[b-c]+', 'abcd'), ('\\bfoo\\b', 'afoo foo_ foo'),
    ('\\Bo', 'o oo'), ('\\b', ' '), ('\\b$', 'ab'), ('.+', 'a\nb'), ('.*$', 'ab\n'),
    ('(a*?)(b|$)', 'aa'), ('(a|ab|abc)c', 'abcc'), ('(?:a|b)+?b', 'aabab'), ('a|b|', 'c'),
    ('\\.\\*\\+\\?\\(\\)\\[\\]\\{\\}\\|\\^\\$\\\\', '.*+?()[]{}|^$\\'), ('\\t+', 'a\t\tb'),
    ('(a)|(b)|(c)', 'c'), ('((((a))))', 'a'), ('(a(b(c)?)?)?d', 'abd'),
    ('(\\w+)\\s(\\w+)$', 'one two three'), ('(?:(a)|b)(?:(c)|d)', 'bd'), ('(a?)((ab)?)(b?)', 'ab'),
    ('(.)+', 'abc'), ('(..)*?$', 'abcde'), ('a{0,2}?a', 'aaa'), ('(?:ab|a)(bc|c)', 'abc'),
    ('(a{1,3}?)(a+)', 'aaaa'), ('^(?:a?){3}a{3}$', 'aaa'), ('(a*)b', 'xaab\n'),
    ('a*', 'baaa'), ('a*?', 'aa'), ('(a|b)*', 'abba'), ('\\b\\w', 'ab cd'), ('$|a', 'ba'),
]
'
# Validator body for 192_pike_regex. build.py prepends the GEN string literal
# (gen.py: seeded generator, pathological set, hand-picked cases) and emits the
# result as the task's python validation script. The oracle for the random and
# hand-picked cases is CPython's own re, run here in the validator process; the
# pathological expectations are fixed by construction (re itself would hang).
import io, json, os, re, subprocess, sys, tokenize

D = '/tmp/eval_pike192'
SRC = os.path.join(D, 'rx.py')
SEED_SEARCH, N_SEARCH = 0x192A5EED, 14000
SEED_ITER, N_ITER = 0x192B17E4, 1500
DIFF_TIMEOUT_S = 8
PATH_TIMEOUT_S = 4

BANNED = {'re', '_sre', 'sre_compile', 'sre_parse', 'sre_constants', 'regex', 'fnmatch',
          'glob', 'importlib', '__import__', 'builtins', '__builtins__', 'exec', 'eval',
          'modules', 'subprocess', 'os', 'posix', 'pty', 'ctypes', 'multiprocessing',
          '_posixsubprocess', 'breakpoint'}


def fail(msg):
    print(msg)
    sys.exit(1)


if not os.path.isfile(SRC):
    fail('missing ' + SRC)
src = open(SRC, encoding='utf-8', errors='replace').read()
try:
    names = {t.string for t in tokenize.generate_tokens(io.StringIO(src).readline)
             if t.type == tokenize.NAME}
except (tokenize.TokenError, SyntaxError, IndentationError):
    fail('rx.py does not tokenize')
hit = sorted(names & BANNED)
if hit:
    fail('forbidden api: ' + ', '.join(hit))

g = {'__name__': '_gen'}
exec(GEN, g)


def spans(m):
    return [None if m.span(k) == (-1, -1) else list(m.span(k)) for k in range(m.re.groups + 1)]


search_cases = [list(c) for c in g['TRICKY']] + [list(c) for c in g['gen_cases'](SEED_SEARCH, N_SEARCH)]
iter_cases = [list(c) for c in g['TRICKY']] + [list(c) for c in g['gen_cases'](SEED_ITER, N_ITER)]
want_search = [None if m is None else spans(m) for m in (re.search(p, t) for p, t in search_cases)]
want_iter = [[spans(m) for m in re.finditer(p, t)] for p, t in iter_cases]
path_cases = [[p, t] for p, t, _ in g['pathological']()]
want_path = [None if e is None else [list(x) if x else None for x in e]
             for _, _, e in g['pathological']()]

RUNNER = r'''
import json, sys
# stdlib modules that compile regexes at import time are loaded before re is
# disabled, so a solution may still use them
import abc, array, bisect, collections, copy, dataclasses, enum, functools, heapq
import io, itertools, math, operator, pathlib, random, string, typing, importlib.util
import _sre, re as _re
def _blocked(*a, **k):
    raise RuntimeError("the re engine is disabled for this task")
_sre.compile = _blocked
_re.purge()
del _re, _sre
_spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("rx", "/tmp/eval_pike192/rx.py")
_m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(_spec)
_spec.loader.exec_module(_m)
_job = json.loads(sys.stdin.read())
_out = sys.stdout
def _norm(r):
    if r is None:
        return None
    return [None if x is None else [int(x[0]), int(x[1])] for x in r]
def _one(fn, p, t):
    try:
        r = fn(p, t)
        if _job["mode"] == "iter":
            return [_norm(x) for x in r]
        return _norm(r)
    except BaseException as e:
        return {"err": type(e).__name__}
fn = getattr(_m, "finditer" if _job["mode"] == "iter" else "search", None)
if not callable(fn):
    _out.write("
@@NOFN@@
"); _out.flush(); sys.exit(0)
for _i, (_p, _t) in enumerate(_job["cases"]):
    _r = _one(fn, _p, _t)
    _out.write("
@@R@@" + json.dumps([_i, _r]) + "
")
    _out.flush()
'''


def run(mode, cases, timeout):
    """Returns (results, timed_out, crash_tail)."""
    job = json.dumps({'mode': mode, 'cases': cases})
    p = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', '-c', RUNNER], cwd=D,
                         stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                         stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
    timed_out = False
    try:
        out, err = p.communicate(job, timeout=timeout)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        p.kill()
        out, err = p.communicate()
        timed_out = True
    if '@@NOFN@@' in out:
        fail('rx.py defines no %s()' % ('finditer' if mode == 'iter' else 'search'))
    res = {}
    for line in out.splitlines():
        if line.startswith('@@R@@'):
            try:
                i, r = json.loads(line[5:])
                res[i] = r
            except ValueError:
                pass
    tail = (err.strip().splitlines() or ['exit %s' % p.returncode])[-1][:160]
    return res, timed_out, tail


def compare(label, res, want, timed_out, tail, timeout):
    for i, w in enumerate(want):
        if i not in res:
            if timed_out:
                fail('%s case %d: timed out (%ds for the whole set)' % (label, i, timeout))
            fail('%s case %d: rx.py crashed: %s' % (label, i, tail))
        r = res[i]
        if isinstance(r, dict):
            fail('%s case %d: raised %s' % (label, i, r.get('err')))
        if r != w:
            fail('%s case %d: mismatch' % (label, i))


res, to, tail = run('search', search_cases, DIFF_TIMEOUT_S)
compare('search', res, want_search, to, tail, DIFF_TIMEOUT_S)
res, to, tail = run('iter', iter_cases, DIFF_TIMEOUT_S)
compare('finditer', res, want_iter, to, tail, DIFF_TIMEOUT_S)
res, to, tail = run('search', path_cases, PATH_TIMEOUT_S)
compare('pathological', res, want_path, to, tail, PATH_TIMEOUT_S)
print('OK: %d search, %d finditer, %d pathological cases'
      % (len(search_cases), len(iter_cases), len(path_cases)))
